title: Rava bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 40a, and Hyman places him in the time of Rav Nachman and Rav Huna. In Ketubot 23a: Rabbi Oshaya taught it on the first clause; Rabbah bar Avin taught it on the last clause.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Pesachim 40a explicitly names Rav Nachman and Rav Huna, supporting the contextual expansion of ר״נ and ר״ה. Hyman’s heading Rava and separate Ketubot quotation Rabbah remain distinct.

William Davidson Pesachim 40a explicitly names Rav Nachman, Rav Huna, and Rava bar Avin; Ketubot 23a has Rabbi Oshaya and Rabbah bar Avin. The heading’s Rava and the quotation’s Rabbah remain distinct forms. Their chronological association is Hyman’s inference, not an identity or chronology admission.
